titre: Étiqueter les publicités des concurrents par étape du tunnel
description: Les annonces des concurrents exportées d'une bibliothèque publicitaire (LinkedIn, Meta, Google) passent devant Jev avec leur texte et leur bouton ; il rend l'étape du tunnel visée par chaque annonce. Le comptage par annonceur et par étape montre où chacun met son budget (notoriété, contenu, démo, clients existants) et où le vôtre a une place. Les étapes sont classiques : gardez-les, ou ajoutez les vôtres.

etape_tunnel.instructions: This is a paid ad from a competitor (`annonceur`): `texte_annonce` is the visible copy and `bouton` the call to action label. Which stage of the funnel does the ad target? Decide on what the ad asks the reader to do and what it offers in return.

criteria.notoriete: Brand or story with nothing to download or buy: a manifesto, a mission, a founder quote, a slogan, a 'discover' or 'learn more' button leading to the home page.
criteria.consideration: Offers a piece of content in exchange for attention or an email: guide, ebook, webinar, benchmark, case study, checklist, template, comparison, newsletter.
criteria.conversion: Asks for a purchase decision or a sales contact: demo, free trial, quote, pricing, discount, limited offer, 'book a call', 'start now', 'sign up'.
criteria.fidelisation: Speaks to existing customers or users: new feature, upgrade, customer event, referral program, renewal, community, customer portal.
criteria.recrutement: A job ad or an employer brand message: 'we are hiring', open positions, life at the company.
criteria.unclear: Text too short or too vague to place, or an ad without any visible offer or button.
